name: Sniper projectile and telegraph VFX component pack

godot_import.filtering: use project pixel-art default; runtime Texture2D consumers must not enable smoothing

runtime_mapping.sniper_shatter_rounds: rotate the right-facing projectile along travel; intended display 48x24; safe for repeated fan shots
runtime_mapping.sniper_deadeye_rifle: center endpoint impact at the locked hit position; intended display 96x96
runtime_mapping.sniper_spotter_scope_telegraph: scale the semi-transparent ring to the actual pending damage radius; do not force opaque modulation
runtime_mapping.sniper_spotter_scope_impact: center the shell impact after the telegraph delay; intended display 144x144

assets.role: repeatable physical projectile, right-facing canonical source

Object only: no gun, no shooter, no explosion, no text, no border, no background.
